Locators are printed journal page numbers (231-247; PDF page = printed - 230). An Alberta LEAP study of ammonia and ethylene. Main file (4 examples) holds the only technology-level SEC values, all reprinted: Canadian natural-gas ammonia plants 29.7-42.3 (avg 34.4) GJ/t NH3 net incl. feedstock (NRCan 2008), modern plants about 28 GJ/t (Rafiqul 2005), Canadian industry 33.1 GJ/t (Sect. 4.1), ethane cracking 17-21 GJ/t ethylene (Ren 2008). _measures.csv: the 14 scenarios of Table 4 / Table A-1 with energy saving, capital cost of the efficient and existing technology, O&M change (2010 CAD per t product) and Table 5 cost of saved energy. _other-values: yields, global intensity, Table A-2 (US 1994, HHV, incl. feedstock) and Table A-3 (reprinted from IEA 2009 = Saygin 2011 data). Not loaded: LEAP scenario results (Table 6), cost curves (Figs 8-9, chart values), Alberta plant list. Traps: (1) Table 4 savings differ from Table A-1 for scenarios 3 (5.8 vs 3.31 GJ/t), 11 (0.067 vs 0.67) and 12 (1 vs 1.17); A-1 values used, both noted. (2) Table 4 reference numbers [20],[21],[23] point to the appendix reference list, not the main list. (3) Table A-1 capital costs are per t product with no statement of whether per annual tonne; cost basis not stated. (4) Scenario 9 is called CHP in Table 4 and "combined cycle technology" in Table A-1 and the figures.
